notes: Kindly note that all listed entrance fees and activity prices include applicable service charges and currency exchange differences, and may differ from Indonesia Ground handling (Local Rates).

expect.title: Walking Distance
expect.body: Distance between 3 Star Hotel to Malioboro Street is within 1km and 15 mins walk.

expect.title: Double Sharing Occupancy
expect.body: For 3 Star Hotel, triple sharing has to use an extra bed. Triple sharing with a proper bed is only available at 4 Star Hotel.

expect.title: Transportation
expect.body: Tour to Timang Beach will be using Jeep (max 4 pax / Jeep). Journey to Timang will be bumpy and perilous.

expect.title: Meals
expect.body: Meals provided during the trip will be local Indonesian food.

expect.title: Heavy Traffic
expect.body: Please expect some delays during the trip due to frequent heavy traffic.

expect.title: Arrival / Departure
expect.body: Suggested arrival and departure times are at noon. Late arrivals or early departures will not be refunded for activities and meals.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Single supplement: additional RM550 per person.
Late booking surcharge of RM50/booking will apply for bookings made less than 45 days before the departure date.
This package is valid until the 31st March 2027 travel period.
Itinerary, price and flight are subject to change accordingly.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements 14 days before the trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity before booking any connecting domestic flight.

deposit.text: prior to departure for full payment
